
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/yl97/p/22137189" title="发布于 2026-08-01 20:54">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">Springboot2.x配置ObjectMapper日期格式化不生效</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p>问题起因：与前端对接接口发现日期时间输出格式是数组，而代码中又有ObjectMapper格式化日期配置</p>
<p>环境：springboot2.x+jdk1.8</p>
<p>相关代码配置类</p>
<pre><code>@Configuration
public class JacksonConfig {
    @Primary
    @Bean
    public ObjectMapper objectMapper() {
        ObjectMapper objectMapper = new ObjectMapper();
        JavaTimeModule javaTimeModule = new JavaTimeModule();
        javaTimeModule.addDeserializer(LocalDateTime.class, new LocalDateTimeDeserializer(DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss")));
        javaTimeModule.addSerializer(LocalDateTime.class, new LocalDateTimeSerializer(DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss")));
        //省略LocalDate、LocalTime的配置
        objectMapper.registerModule(javaTimeModule);
        objectMapper.configure(SerializationFeature.WRITE_DATES_AS_TIMESTAMPS, false);
        objectMapper.setTimeZone(TimeZone.getTimeZone("Asia/Shanghai"));
        objectMapper.registerModule(javaTimeModule);
        return objectMapper;
    }
}

@EnableWebMvc
@Component
public class MyWebMvcConfig implements WebMvcConfigurer {
     //省略一些常用配置
}
</code></pre>
<p><strong>问题排查思路：</strong></p>
<ol>
<li>使用自动注入ObjectMapper，查看bean配置是否生效，bebug结果显示配置是注入到bean中<br>
<img alt="PixPin_2026-08-01_20-17-14" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2104359/202608/2104359-20260801201704838-1112381635.png" class="lazyload"></li>
<li>通过调用栈debug到AbstractJackson2HttpMessageConverter类，发现与注入的ObjectMapper的配置不一致<br>
<code>private ObjectMapper selectObjectMapper(Class&lt;?&gt; targetType, @Nullable MediaType targetMediaType)</code><br>
<img alt="PixPin_2026-08-01_20-21-13" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2104359/202608/2104359-20260801202052784-1749383665.png" class="lazyload"></li>
<li>搜索发现代码注入@EnableWebMvc。将注解注释后重新bebug发现配置生效了。</li>
</ol>
<p><strong>解决方案：</strong></p>
<p><strong>方案一：直接删除@EnableWebMvc注解重启生效</strong></p>
<p><strong>方案二：保持原代码不动，在实现<code>WebMvcConfigurer</code>的类中重写<code>extendMessageConverters</code>方法</strong></p>
<pre><code>@Override
    public void extendMessageConverters(List&lt;HttpMessageConverter&lt;?&gt;&gt; converters) {
        for (HttpMessageConverter&lt;?&gt; converter : converters) {
            if (converter instanceof MappingJackson2HttpMessageConverter) {
                ((MappingJackson2HttpMessageConverter) converter).setObjectMapper(objectMapper);
                break;
            }
        }
    }
</code></pre>
<p><strong>方案三：在LocalDateTime、LocalDate、LocalTime等字段使用<code>@JsonFormat</code>,如果接受参数类型也是日期时间类型，建议也加上<code>@DateTimeFormat</code></strong><br>
因为是接手别人的代码，线上已经运行，没有办法只有选择方案二、方案三</p>


</div>
<div class="clear"></div>
